metadata.description: agentjoey's collection of Claude tools and skills.

plugins.name: behavior-driven-testing
plugins.description: Test at the real boundary with real data and probe the running system before claiming a feature works. A green gate is not 'works'.

plugins.name: linear-roadmap-maintenance
plugins.description: Make Linear the work queue: pull the top backlog issue by priority, work it, close it in the same session. Reconciliation is the repair path, gated so it costs nothing when the loop is working.
